      05Case study

      Live eels, Egypt to Korea

      One line I built and ran end to end for a Korean trading branch in Cairo: sourcing at Egyptian farms, CITES and health paperwork, live-cargo air freight and negotiation with Korean buyers — 100+ kg a week.

      01 · Sourcing
      Suppliers qualified on both sides

      Identified and qualified suppliers in Egypt and Korea, agreed grading, packing and weekly volumes, and compared quotes before committing.

      Egypt · Korea
      02 · Compliance
      CITES permits and health certificates

      Anguilla is a CITES-listed species: export permits, veterinary/health certificates and customs export documents had to be right before every shipment.

      CITES
      03 · Live cargo
      Air freight built for live fish

      Packing and airline handling for live cargo, booked with freight forwarders, with shipment scheduling tight enough to protect survival rates on arrival.

      Air freight
      04 · Commercial
      Price and terms in Korean

      Negotiated price, Incoterms (FOB, CIF) and lead times directly with Korean buyers in Korean and English.

      KR · EN
      100+ kga week, live
      ≈USD 1,000per shipment
      5 monthsproject-based branch role

      Market context: Egypt’s live-eel exports averaged USD 15.6/kg FOB (USD 7.6/kg to Korea) and Korean wholesale live eel trades around USD 27/kg — so a 100 kg weekly line is a genuinely high-value niche, not a volume business.

      06Case study

      600 orders a month, no surprises

      Order-to-cash for 50+ multinational accounts inside Kerry Group’s Kuala Lumpur shared service centre: order entry to invoice, exceptions cleared before the customer notices, and the reporting automated.

      01 · Volume & accuracy
      End-to-end order management in SAP ERP

      Order entry, amendments, pricing, master-data validation, delivery scheduling, billing/invoicing and credit notes — holding 96%+ order accuracy across roughly 600 orders a month.

      SAP ERP
      02 · Exceptions
      Backorders and blocks cleared daily

      Daily exception and backorder management with planning, logistics, finance and customer service — which kept 100% on-time delivery on critical accounts.

      100% on-time
      03 · Escalations & cash
      Root cause, written follow-up, money in

      Root-cause analysis and written follow-up on high-value accounts; overdue invoice follow-up, payment matching and billing disputes resolved with finance.

      AR · Collections
      04 · Automation & training
      Tools the whole team kept using

      Excel macros, formulas and trackers over SAP extracts — adopted team-wide — plus 10–15 new joiners trained and the onboarding documentation written.
